# Phase 2 holdout deferments

The failed 2026-07-31 Phase 2 holdout did not establish a safely isolated
legacy comparison. That comparison is deferred under D6.

The next Pipeline V1 holdout may validate the isolated V1 path without a
legacy candidate comparison. This deferment does not authorize changing the
live controller, changing the Ollama lifecycle, enabling Pipeline V1 globally,
or beginning Phase 3. A future comparison requires a separately verified
legacy fixture and an explicit isolation record before execution.
